headline: On last trading day, Sensex fell 289 points amid inflation concerns, despite weekly market gains

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on market sentiment during the last trading session.
Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices provided support earlier in the week.
PSU Banks led sectoral gains to help markets extend their weekly rally.
Currency depreciation boosted October apparel exports despite subdued volume growth.
whatHappening: Sensex slipped 289 points in the last trading session on Friday, November 13.
NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their overall weekly rally for the third consecutive week.
CMS Info reported a 10% increase in Q2 profit with record services revenue.
Mahanadi Coalfields filed an RHP for a proposed IPO valued at nearly ₹9,500 crore.
summary: Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 16 November. On the last trading day, Sensex fell 289 points as inflation worries pressed on investor confidence, though indices logged gains for the third straight week. Meanwhile, CMS Info reported strong Q2 profits backed by record revenue.
